text:
Elena: Quick heads-up — Orion (SI) ran into a hard stop with Medstream's private deployment. VPC peering failed and model pulls are timing out. They asked for an architecture review + fast escalation path. Can we triage? @Sam @Priya :wave
Sam: I can take this. Do we have the customer's VPC CIDRs and error logs? Also what model variant are they trying to pull?
Elena: Sent their summary to the thread: CIDR 10.10.0.0/16 (customer) vs our connector 10.10.0.0/24 overlap, attempts to peer blocked. Model is rwd-2.1-quant (private). Logs show `connection refused` when fetching weights and `403` for model metadata.
Priya: Overlap will definitely block peering. Two quick options: 1) ask customer to allocate a non-overlapping CIDR range (fast but sometimes blocked by infra), or 2) use NAT/proxy in our connector VPC and route model pulls via our egress IPs. Option 2 needs firewall rules and signed cert update.
Jorge: From runtime side: if peering can't be fixed immediately we can enable a temporary fallback — serve a smaller compatible model from Dedicated pool in the same region to prevent user-visible downtime. Need to confirm latency impact and auth path.
Mika: Security notes: if we route through our connector egress we must ensure KMS keys are accessible and audit logs capture the request. For Medstream (PHI-ish) we need HSM-backed key policy exceptions documented.
Sam: Ok. Action items I propose: 1) Priya to confirm if customer can reassign CIDR (ETA today?) 2) Mika to validate KMS/HSM exceptions with compliance and list required docs 3) Jorge to stand up temporary Dedicated fallback + config snippet 4) Elena/Orion to open escalation ticket with customer contact and timeline.
Priya: Reached out to Orion's infra lead — they're checking CIDR reassign but said it could take 24-48h. Suggested we prepare fallback.
Jorge: I'll prep the fallback. Quick config I will use (will paste to support ticket):
```
runtime: dedicated
model: rwd-2.1-quant-fallback
network:
  allowlist: ["10.20.0.0/16"]
  egress_ip: "34.82.15.7"
auth:
  token: "<service-to-service>")
```
Jorge: Also need to know whether the customer requires mutual TLS on the model fetch — if so the fallback won't help.
Elena: Orion says Medstream requires mTLS for all inbound connections. They're open to us pulling models if we present client certs.
Mika: If mTLS is required we need CA chain and cert provisioning plan. That will add ops steps but doable. Compliance will need the cert rotation plan.
Amber: I'm going to open an internal escalation for delivery engineering and legal review. Ticket created: INC-2345. Noting response SLA target: 6 hours for initial remediation plan. @escalation-bot please track. :spiral_calendar:
escalation-bot: New escalation logged INC-2345 assigned to delivery-lead@redwood.team, priority=high.
Sam: Thanks Amber. For immediate next step I'll coordinate with Jorge to test the Dedicated fallback using synthetic traffic and confirm perf. Priya please keep Orion in the loop and capture whether they can provide CA chain for mTLS.
Priya: Will do. I'll also capture customer contact + a timeline for CIDR change and share in the ticket.
Elena: Thanks all. Let's aim to have a remediation plan in the ticket within 6 hours. I'll follow up again after Jorge posts test results. :thumbsup:
